text:
Maggie: Heads up — saw a routing mismatch in staging. Requests with custom header `x-rlw-tenant` + old UA `RedwoodPlayer/0.9` are sometimes getting routed to shared pool and charged to default tenant.
Devon: hmm. Is UA the source of truth here or the custom header? we should prefer explicit headers.
Maggie: currently gateway prefers UA-derived routing for legacy clients if `x-rlw-tenant` absent. But some clients send both and UA normalization rules are messy.
Kai: propose rule: precedence = signed header > x-rlw-tenant > cookie JWT > UA inferral. UA only as last resort. Also we need spoof mitigation.
Enrique: +1. Also console should surface "inferred vs declared" routing so product knows when UA inference was used (and who paid).
Maggie: example rule I've been testing:
```
match:
  - header: x-rlw-route-sig
    verify: kms:rlw-routing-key
  - header: x-rlw-tenant
    present: true
action:
  route: tenant_pool
fallback:
  route: shared_pool
```
Devon: Nice. For UA, we should normalize and map a few well-known tokens only. No fuzzy substring matching.
Kai: we should also instrument a telemetry flag per request: `routing_reason` = ["signed_header","tenant_header","cookie","ua_infer"]. Make that available in trace and per-tenant billing view.
Enrique: Billing needs an accuracy metric. If routing_reason==ua_infer then tag `billing_confidence=low` in dashboard and exclude from auto-charge until reviewed.
sre-bot: Incident detected: spike in shared_pool costs (23% over baseline) between 12:03 and 12:07 UTC. Link: https://ops.redwood.example/incidents/678
Maggie: oof. Could we add short-term mitigation: reject `x-rlw-tenant` if `x-rlw-route-sig` missing for high-cost endpoints, and log a soft-fail hook so we can roll back via canary?
Devon: doable. We'll add a canary config: `enforce_signed: true` for 10% of traffic initially. Ops can toggle via rollout UI.
Kai: UX note — in rollouts console, make the enforcement toggle show expected impact on routes and projected cost delta.
Enrique: also add a small "verify header signature" endpoint for clients to test their signing before rollout.
Maggie: agreed. I'll open a PR with the gateway change + telemetry fields. patch will include migration plan for legacy UA-only clients.
Devon: thanks. ping me when PR is up, I'll add KMS verification and unit tests.
Kai: I'll wire telemetry and dashboard bits.
Enrique: I'll work on billing exclusion rules and the console warning for low confidence charges.
Maggie: Thanks team. Let's aim to ship canary by EOD tomorrow. :rocket:
